hero.title: Know where your money goes, before it runs out.
hero.sub: SmartWallet suggests a category for every expense, splits your monthly budget the way you choose, and nudges you before you overspend. No bank connection needed.
hero.note: Free plan forever · No card needed · Cancel anytime

story.title: How SmartWallet keeps your money from disappearing

loop1.title: Log an expense in seconds
loop1.body: Type the amount and a short note. SmartWallet suggests the category — “Highlands coffee” is Food & Drinks — and remembers your choice next time. From any screen, three taps.
loop1.b1: Category suggested automatically, you always decide
loop1.b2: Learns whenever you change a category
loop1.b3: Defaults to the wallet you used last

loop2.title: Split your monthly budget in a minute
loop2.body: Pick 50/30/20 or 6 Jars, enter your income, and SmartWallet pre-fills an amount for each category. Want it different? Edit any line, or set your own percentages.
loop2.savingsNote: Savings are set aside for goals, not as a spending budget.

loop3.title: Get a nudge before you overspend, not after
loop3.body: When a category reaches 80% and 100%, you get a notification in the app and by email. No scolding — just how much is left and how much you can spend each day.
loop3.s2body: 245,000 VND left — about 27,000 VND a day.
loop3.s3body: 60,000 VND over. Other categories still have room.

s1.title: Create your first wallet
s1.body: Cash, a bank account or a MoMo/ZaloPay wallet, with the balance you have now.

s2.title: Pick a budget template
s2.body: Enter your income, choose 50/30/20, 6 Jars or your own split, then adjust.

s3.title: Log spending every day
s3.body: SmartWallet handles category suggestions, tracks your budgets and reminds you in time.

voices.title: People using SmartWallet
voices.caption: Illustrative characters built from SmartWallet's target users.

linh.name: Linh
linh.role: 21, third-year student, Ho Chi Minh City
linh.quote: Every month-end I used to panic because I had no idea where my money went. Now I open the app and see what I can spend today. When my food budget was nearly gone, the app nudged me and I started cooking more.

minh.name: Minh
minh.quote: I'm saving for a house deposit. After splitting my budget 50/30/20, I can see every month whether my savings are on track. Exporting a CSV at year-end to check things is really handy too.

thao.name: Thảo
thao.quote: My income goes up and down, so it's easy to overspend. I set my alert at 70% and log expenses on my phone in under ten seconds.

pricing.title: Simple pricing
pricing.sub: Start free. Upgrade when you need more, and cancel anytime.
pricing.freeFor: For starting to track your spending
pricing.note: Payment is a simulation during the trial period.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Passwords are hashed with bcrypt, connections use HTTPS, and administrators cannot see your individual transactions. When you delete your account, your data is fully removed after 30 days.
faq.q2: Does SmartWallet connect to my bank?
faq.a2: No. SmartWallet never reads your bank or e-wallet accounts. You log each expense yourself (it takes seconds) or import a CSV file with Premium.
faq.a3: Yes. Cancel whenever you like and you go back to the Free plan; your data is kept.
faq.a4: If you are paid on the 5th, set your month start day to 5. Your budget then runs from the 5th of this month to the 4th of next month instead of the calendar month.
faq.a6: Not yet. SmartWallet works well in a phone browser, from 360 px wide screens.

final.title: Ready to know where your money goes?
final.sub: Creating an account takes under a minute.
